title: Evil Dead II
review:
This is the only movie you'll find on this website with a perfect score, because it is that good. I am heavily biased towards this movie, but man, am I glad I've watched it so many times. It is something that cannot be replicated, and words can't express how special it is.

It was made by the same guy who made the original Spider-Man, Sam Raimi. Bruce Campbell makes Ash feel like a goofy fucking hunk, and God bless him.

Reviewing this is pointless. It is perfect with all its flaws, and that is that.
